reviews.text: I really like this Toner! It has a soft, milky texture that feels more nourishing than a watery toner but still absorbs comfortably into my skin. After applying, my skin feels hydrated, smooth and soft without feeling greasy. I also like how it gives my skin a fresh, healthy-looking glow and layers nicely with the rest of my skincare routine. It’s become a lovely step in my daily routine, especially when my skin feels dry or dehydrated.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款化妝水！佢有柔和嘅奶狀質地，比起水狀化妝水更加滋潤，但仍然能夠舒適咁吸收到皮膚入面。塗完之後，皮膚感覺水潤、順滑、柔軟，唔會油膩。我亦鍾意佢令皮膚有一種清新、健康嘅光澤，同護膚程序嘅其他產品疊用都好好。佢已經成為我日常護膚嘅一個好好嘅步驟，尤其係皮膚感覺乾燥或者缺水嗰時。

reviews.text:
Review Title

Gentle, Hydrating and Perfect for My Routine

Review

I’ve been really enjoying this toner in my skincare routine. The texture is light and milky, and it feels very gentle and comfortable on my skin. It provides a nice boost of hydration without feeling heavy or sticky.

I also love how it leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth and fresh. It layers easily with the rest of my skincare and works well both morning and night.

Overall, it’s a lovely toner for anyone looking for hydration and a more even-looking, healthy glow. I’m very happy with it and would definitely recommend giving it a try! Thanks for this opportunity!
reviews.zh:
評論標題

溫和、補水，好啱我嘅護膚程序

評論

我一直好享受用呢款化妝水嚟護膚。質地輕盈、奶狀，塗喺皮膚上感覺非常溫和、舒適。佢提供咗好好嘅補水效果，但唔會覺得厚重或者黏膩。

我亦好鍾意佢令皮膚感覺柔軟、順滑、清爽。佢容易同護膚程序嘅其他產品疊用，朝早同晚上用都好好。

總括嚟講，對於想要補水、膚色更加均勻健康有光澤嘅人嚟講，呢款係一款好好嘅化妝水。我好滿意，一定會推薦大家試吓！多謝畀我呢個機會！

reviews.text:
This is such a beautiful milky toner! The creamy texture feels much more nourishing than a traditional watery toner, and it leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth and deeply hydrated.

I really like the combination of niacinamide and tranexamic acid for supporting a more even-looking complexion, while the multiple forms of hyaluronic acid and ceramides help keep the skin moisturized and comfortable.

It gives my skin that healthy, fresh glow without making it feel heavy. It’s especially nice when my skin is feeling a little dry and needs an extra layer of hydration. I can definitely see this becoming a staple in my skincare routine. 💗
reviews.zh:
呢款奶狀化妝水真係好靚！佢嘅奶霜質地比起傳統水狀化妝水更加滋養，用完之後皮膚感覺柔軟、順滑、深層補水。

我好鍾意佢結合咗煙酰胺同傳明酸，幫助令膚色睇落更加均勻，而多種透明質酸同神經醯胺就幫助保持皮膚滋潤、舒適。

佢令皮膚有種健康、清新嘅光澤，但唔會令皮膚感覺厚重。當皮膚有少少乾燥，需要多一層水分嗰時，尤其好用。我肯定會將佢變成我護膚程序入面嘅必備產品。💗

reviews.text: I really like the APRILSKIN TXA Niacinamide 99 Milky Toner! It has a soft, milky texture that feels lightweight and moisturizing on my skin. It absorbs well without feeling sticky, and my skin feels smoother, softer, and more hydrated after using it. I also noticed that my skin looks more radiant and even with consistent use. It’s a lovely toner for adding extra hydration and glow to my routine!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意 APRILSKIN TXA Niacinamide 99 Milky Toner！佢有柔和嘅奶狀質地，塗喺皮膚上感覺輕盈、滋潤。吸收得好，唔會黏膩，用完之後皮膚感覺更加幼滑、柔軟、水潤。我亦留意到，持續使用之後，皮膚睇落更加有光澤、膚色更均勻。係一款好好嘅化妝水，可以為我嘅護膚程序加多啲水分同光澤感！

reviews.text:
I've received this toner in a set that contains 3 products.

Generally, they all are so cosmetically elegant, from the high-quality packaging to the neat textures.

The toner isn't just my #1 of the 3, but one of the most beautiful toners I've ever tried. I've been LOVING this. It's a very thick, pinkish fluid that smells like sweet strawberry candy. It feels like melted marshmallows in the most beautiful way possible. 

It DEEPLY hydrates & gives an instant gorgeous glow. Despite its very thick texture, it feels extremely lightweight & hugs the skin with comfort.

It gorgeous year-round.
I highly recommend you guys to check this one out.
reviews.zh:
我收到嘅係一套三件裝嘅化妝水。

整體嚟講，佢哋嘅外觀都好優雅，由高質素嘅包裝到整齊嘅質地都係咁。

呢款化妝水唔單止係三款之中我最鍾意嘅，仲係我用過最靚嘅化妝水之一。我一直都好鍾意。佢係一款好濃稠、粉紅色嘅液體，聞落好似甜甜嘅士多啤梨糖。塗落去嘅感覺好似融化咗嘅棉花糖，以最美嘅方式呈現。

佢深層補水，並且即時帶嚟漂亮嘅光澤。雖然質地好濃稠，但係感覺非常輕盈，舒適地貼住皮膚。

全年都好靚。
我強烈推薦大家試吓呢款。

reviews.text:
I’ve been really enjoying this milky toner. The texture is lightweight yet nourishing, and it absorbs quickly without leaving my skin feeling sticky. It layers beautifully with the rest of my skincare routine and gives my skin a healthy, hydrated glow.

I like that it combines Tranexamic Acid, 5% Niacinamide, Alpha-Arbutin, and Ceramide NP, making it a great option for improving the look of dullness while helping support the skin barrier. With consistent use, my skin feels softer, looks brighter, and appears more even-toned.

The bottle is generous in size, so it lasts a long time even with daily use. If you’re looking for a hydrating toner with brightening ingredients that feels comfortable on the skin, I definitely recommend giving this one a try.
reviews.zh:
我一直都好享受用呢款奶狀化妝水。質地輕盈但滋養，吸收快，用完唔會令皮膚黏膩。佢同我嘅其他護膚產品疊用都好好，令皮膚有健康、水潤嘅光澤。

我鍾意佢結合咗傳明酸、5% 煙酰胺、熊果素同神經醯胺 NP，對於改善暗啞膚色、幫助支持皮膚屏障都係一個好選擇。持續使用之後，我嘅皮膚感覺更柔軟、睇落更亮白、膚色更加均勻。

樽裝份量好大，即使每日都用，都可以用好耐。如果你想搵一款可以補水、又有提亮成分、用落去感覺舒服嘅化妝水，我絕對推薦你試吓呢款。

reviews.text: This toner feels super gentle on my skin and absorbs quickly without any sticky feeling. The milky texture is really soothing and perfect for my sensitive areas. I love the pink color on this!! I’ve noticed a visible improvement in my skin tone after a few uses — it looks brighter, more even, and calm. I love that it contains TXA and 99% Niacinamide, which really help with fading dark spots and strengthening my skin barrier. Highly recommend it if you’re looking for a toner that hydrates, brightens, and soothes all at once!
reviews.zh: 呢款化妝水塗喺皮膚上好溫和，吸收快，冇任何黏膩感。奶狀質地真係好舒緩，啱我嘅敏感位置。我好鍾意佢嘅粉紅色！！用咗幾次之後，我見到膚色有明顯改善，睇落更加亮白、更加均勻、平靜。我鍾意佢含有傳明酸同 99% 煙酰胺，真係有助淡化暗瘡印同加強皮膚屏障。如果你想搵一款可以同時補水、提亮同舒緩嘅化妝水，強力推薦！

reviews.text: This toner features 5% niacinamide and a low dose of tranexamic acid (TXA), aiming to brighten the skin and improve tone. Its milky texture absorbs easily and provides good hydration without feeling sticky. Suitable for sensitive skin, it includes added ceramides and hyaluronic acid for extra moisture. However, the TXA concentration is quite low, so results on pigmentation may be subtle. Great for those looking for a gentle brightening and hydrating toner.
reviews.zh: 呢款化妝水含有 5% 煙酰胺同少量傳明酸（TXA），目標係提亮膚色、改善膚色均勻度。奶狀質地易於吸收，提供良好補水效果，唔會覺得黏膩。適合敏感皮膚，另外加入咗神經醯胺同透明質酸，增加水分。不過，傳明酸濃度相當低，所以對色素沉澱嘅效果可能比較輕微。啱想搵溫和提亮同補水化妝水嘅人。
